newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds stalled by volatile Chicago.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds stalled by volatile Chicago.

text.p: Volatile trading on the Chicago futures market at the end of last week and on Monday stalled the UK meals and feeds market.

Sellers reduced asking prices for high protein by as much as four stg a tonne following the lower Chicago close on Friday, but most players kept to the sidelines ahead of an expected sharply higher opening in the U.S.
Apart from soymeal there were few other changes with rapemeal ex-mill Hull and Liverpool one stg up while most other sectors of the market were unchanged.
Only one trade was reported when home produced wheat feed pellets fetched 89 stg for spot ex-mill London.
